title: Predictive Maintenance Equipment Tender
scope_summary: Tender for the procurement of predictive maintenance equipment. This aims to support predictive maintenance planning and reduce unplanned interventions through continuous asset condition monitoring and AI-driven insights.

title: Testbed 2026 Digital Twin as a Service
scope_summary: Call for research and implementation proposals to further develop, improve and implement the approach of Digital Twins as a Service, with a focus on unlocking and using dynamic data (sensors) within digital twins.

title: HSE 23895 Dynamic Purchasing System Qualification; Health Document Management System
scope_summary: Request to Participate in a Dynamic Purchasing System for a Health Document Management System. The system should enable digital management of health files, support safe and efficient scanning, uploading and management of documents, and allow remote access for a mobile workforce.

title: Topographical and GPR Surveys for Shamrock Stores Social Housing, Athy, Co. Kildare
scope_summary: Tender for topographical and GPR surveys for a social housing project in Athy, Co. Kildare.

title: VantageRE - ICT & Telephony Tender
scope_summary: Request for Proposal (RFP) to engage a qualified Managed Service Provider (MSP) for comprehensive outsourced IT services, including end-user support, infrastructure and network management, cybersecurity, mobile telephony support, printer management, and strategic IT enablement. The technology environment is designed to support a modern, mobile workforce.
